values.note: $15 per site a night, one rate for everyone (current city fee schedule, undated), paid in the envelope at the drop box.

fees.source: https://www.cityofvassar.org/325/Rental-Fees-Policies ('Riverside Campground: $15 per site/night') + https://www.cityofvassar.org/322/Riverside-RV-Park ('The reservation fee is $15 per night'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.cityofvassar.org/322/Riverside-RV-Park ('The park consists of ten sites with individual electricity (30 AMP) hook ups. A public water source is available for use in the park.'), read 2026-10-25

sites.source: https://www.cityofvassar.org/322/Riverside-RV-Park ('ten sites with individual electricity (30 AMP) hook ups'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No dump station at the park; RV waste tanks can be emptied at the city's Wastewater Treatment Facility (billing form on the city site).

facilities.source: https://www.cityofvassar.org/322/Riverside-RV-Park ('A public water source is available for use in the park.'; 'Did you know you can empty your RV waste water tank at our Wastewater Treatment Facility?'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No advance booking: campers fill in the reservation form/envelope at the park's welcome sign on Cedar Street and put it with the fee in the drop box. Stays overnight, for a weekend or a week. City of Vassar 989-823-8517.

booking.source: https://www.cityofvassar.org/322/Riverside-RV-Park ('Campers are asked to visit the park's welcome sign located on Cedar Street, complete a reservation form/envelope and submit their form with the reservation fee into the park's drop box.'; 'Stay overnight, for the weekend or the week.'; 'Please call the City of Vassar at 989-823-8517'), read 2026-10-25

note: City of Vassar RV park on Cass Avenue by the Cass River, a few blocks from downtown, near Frankenmuth. Kayak and canoe access. --Claude
summary: City pages: $15/site/night (confirmed; undated current schedule, flat rate), ten 30-amp sites (confirmed, derived -> manual), no site water but a public water source (confirmed), no dump on site (city WWTP takes RV waste); booking added as self-registration at the drop box (no advance booking, so reservable false / first-come).
